contract.name: Winter 2026/27 special market rates – FIT & group
contract.tax_note: Inclusive of service charge and all applicable government taxes; non-commissionable (nett)
contract.child_policy_text: Definition of children: 0 – 4.99 years infant, 5 – 11.99 years child. Infant / child sharing parents' room between the ages of 0 – 5.99 would be 100% complimentary. Child supplement with bed – USD 25 on half board basis. Meal reductions / supplements for children: BB reduction USD 2.50, FB supplement USD 12.50, AI supplement USD 22.50 per child per night on the HB rate.
contract.guide_policy_text: Guide policy (HB basis): guide rate USD 70 per night. Guide rooms will be strictly based on availability; guide rooms will be transferred as first priority in case of overbookings.
contract.foc_policy_text: FOC policy (all markets): for every 15 paying pax, the 16th pax is FOC.
contract.cancellation_text: Between 45 and 30 days of travel: 50% cancellation on the total value. Within 30 days of travel: 100% cancellation on the total value. All group allotments need to be finalised and released on or before 30 days from the travel date on all periods except 20 December 2026 – 10 January 2027, when all bookings need to be finalised 45 days prior to arrival. All amendments within the cancellation period will be charged 100% on booked basis. Tentative holds on rooms (group and FIT bookings): a tentative booking remains in the system for 48 hours; without a firm guarantee by letter / voucher it is released automatically without prior notice. All guaranteed bookings are cancelled subject to the contractual terms & conditions.
contract.payment_text: Groups of 5 rooms and above need 50% of the total value paid 45 days prior to arrival (any booking without an advance payment is automatically released according to policy). All bookings: full payment to be made within 30 days prior to the travel date (clients will be held back if payment is not received). No credit facilities would be provided to any partner. Union Resorts reserves the right to charge interest of 2% per month on all delayed outstanding amounts not settled within the stipulated period. Any billing dispute should be notified to the resort accounts department within 7 days of receiving the invoice.
contract.terms_text: GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS. This agent rate agreement is made between the respective Destination Management Company (DMC), foreign travel agent or foreign tour operator and covers the accommodation, dining facilities and excursions at The Blue Water Hotel & Spa, Wadduwa. All rates are quoted in US dollars on the specified board basis inclusive of all applicable taxes and service charge and are non-commissionable. The Blue Water Hotel & Spa reserves the right to add on changes to government taxes, fees and charges from the date of implementation. Check-in 14:00 hrs, check-out 12:00 hrs (no early check-ins and late check-outs will be confirmed until 1 day prior to the arrival / departure date). Service charge and applicable taxes will be charged on any additional service not already shown in this contract. Definition of children: 0 – 4.99 years infant, 5 – 11.99 years child. All room categories can accommodate only one adult extra bed to a double / twin configuration; all double bedrooms and suites can accommodate one extra bed. Twin rooms are strictly based on availability unless blocked during booking. Under any condition of force majeure the resort holds no direct liability to the agent for failure to operate. Any violation of the above terms may result in termination of this agent agreement. Reservations will only be accepted on an e-mail voucher sent to reservations@thebluewatersrilanka.com; enquiries and availability on 0773876579 / 0740796858. TERMS & CONDITIONS: rates are in USD and are non-commissionable; all rates are inclusive of taxes; rates are subject to vary in accordance with government tax / levy changes; the above rates are not valid to be published online on any platform, direct or via a 3rd party agent (if identified, all contracts and bookings will be cancelled with immediate effect); the enclosed rates cannot be extended to the domestic market (Sri Lankan nationals). REMARKS: all vouchers without a rate and market will not be confirmed; any special rate should be sent with an e-mail from the sales person together with a voucher; any special negotiated series / market rate should be stated with a rate code; bookings without the specific market code will be billed on the all-other-market rate; bookings will not be confirmed if the above criteria are not met. Signed for the resort by Ashwin Joseph, Director – Sales and Marketing, Union Resorts & Spas Sri Lanka. Bank: Sampath Bank, Panadura, Sri Lanka — Union Resorts (Pvt) Limited, Thalpitiya, Wadduwa; A/C 0026 1000 1400; SWIFT BSAMLKLX. The contract is to be signed and returned within 02 days of its date and is binding only after the signed copy is received.
contract.voucher_note: Reservations only on an e-mail voucher to reservations@thebluewatersrilanka.com. Vouchers without a rate and a market are not confirmed; a negotiated series / market rate must carry its rate code, otherwise the booking is billed on the all-other-market rate.
contract.notes: The booklet prices the same Deluxe room in a separate table per booking tier (and per market block), so each printed table is a plan of its own — one plan cannot hold two rates for the same room type on the same night. Only half board is printed; BB / FB / AI / RO are derived from the printed per-person meal reductions and supplements (meal_deltas). Only the Deluxe category is priced; Club / Executive / Presidential Suites are Deluxe + a room supplement. The same four PDFs were also sent on 02 Sep 2026 as "FW: Travel Agent Rates - The Blue Water Hotel & Spa, Wadduwa". Cover page: "MASTER RATES - WINTER 2026 -2027 / OTA / WEB / WEDDING, MICE, CORPORATE DIRECT/ DMC / GENERAL"; signed by Ashwin Joseph (Director – Sales and Marketing) and Ajith Wijeyesekera (Managing Director / Chairman). Contract date 17 July 2026 taken from the file name "Winter 2026- 2027 - DMC - THE BLUE WATER HOTEL _ SPA - 17-July -2026.pdf" — no date is printed inside the booklet. The Christmas & New Year's Eve supplement is printed without dates ("Christmas & New Year's Eve Supplement, USD 120 per adult per night on BB / USD 100 on HB, FB, AI; child USD 60 / USD 50"); it is entered on 24 and 31 December 2026 as compulsory gala rows. The Club Suite supplement is USD 50 in winter (USD 40 in both summer booklets). This plan is the "SPECIAL MARKET RATES - (RUSSIA - CIS – EASTERN EUROPE - INDIA - SOUTH ASIA - CHINA - FAR EAST ASIA - DUTCH - SPAIN) / LESS THAN FIT & GROUP TRAVEL RATE" table. The heading names no room threshold, so the plan is entered for both tiers (tier "all"); its four rate lines are identical to the all-market group table.
